sessions.title: On the Farm: Hog Processing Basics
sessions.description: Learn the fundamentals of processing heritage breed pigs. Gain practical knowledge in humane slaughter techniques, scalding, scraping, evisceration and breaking down the carcass for further processing.

sessions.title: On the Farm: Curing Heritage Pork
sessions.description: Take your skills to the next level and explore traditional curing techniques. Learn how to transform primal cuts into classic cured products such as prosciutto, bacon, lonza and coppa. Learn about dry curing, salting, seasoning and hanging protocols.

sessions.title: On the Farm: Making Sausage
sessions.description: Explore the art of sausage making on a real hog farm. Learn to break down fresh pork, blend creative seasonings and master techniques for grinding, stuffing and linking sausages. Whether you're a curious home cook or an aspiring butcher, you'll leave with the knowledge and the links, you need to start crafting your own sausages at home.
sessions.notes: Must reg/drop by 11/12. Food and beverage provided.

sessions.title: On the Farm: Art of Organ Meats
sessions.description: Celebrate sustainable eating and culinary tradition, all starting with the parts most often left behind in butchering. Discover the rich flavors and forgotten wisdom of whole-animal cooking in this hands-on workshop dedicated to organ meats. Come curious, leave inspired and well fed.
sessions.notes: Must reg/drop by 11/13. Food and beverage provided.
